Title: Homepage displays product catalog
Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage 2. Verify product cards are visible
Expected Result: Product catalog loads with at least one product

Title: Valid user login
Steps: 1. Click Sign in 2. Enter valid email and password 3. Submit

Title: Product detail page from homepage
Steps: 1. Click first product card 2. Verify product detail page
Expected Result: Add to cart button visible on product detail page

Title: User registration with valid details
Steps: 1. Click Register 2. Fill first name last name email password 3. Submit
Expected Result: Account created and user logged in with profile menu visible

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps: 1. Click Sign in 2. Enter valid email and wrong password 3. Submit
Expected Result: Login error displayed; user remains unauthenticated

Title: Profile shows registered user details
Steps: 1. Open profile from nav menu 2. Verify email and name fields
Expected Result: Profile email matches logged-in user; first name populated

Title: E2E COD checkout with quantity and invoice
Steps: 1. Open product and set quantity 2 2. Add to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Fill billing address 5. Select Cash on Delivery 6. Click Confirm twice 7. Open My Invoices
Expected Result: Order success message shown; invoice number visible under My Invoices

Title: Search for existing product
Steps: 1. Enter product name in search (e.g. Thor Hammer) 2. Submit search

Title: Search for non-existent product
Steps: 1. Enter random non-existent string 2. Submit search
Expected Result: No results / user-friendly empty state shown

Title: Checkout with single confirm only
Preconditions: User logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Complete billing and select COD 2. Click Confirm once only
Expected Result: Invoice may not generate; order may remain incomplete (validates double-confirm rule)

Title: Add to cart with empty quantity field
Steps: 1. Clear quantity field 2. Click Add to cart
Expected Result: System defaults to 1 or shows validation; cart does not break

Title: Checkout with missing billing fields
Preconditions: User logged in with cart items
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout 2. Leave required address fields empty 3. Attempt to continue
Expected Result: Field-level validation errors displayed; checkout blocked
